verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents table versioning with snapshots, audit trails and time travel, plus branching. Branching lets agent-driven experiments and backfills run in isolation, be evaluated against a fixed test set, and only the winner be promoted to main. That gives version, review and rollback semantics for the data and indexes automations produce, but not for the automation definitions themselves. Missing for 10: versioning of the automation or pipeline definitions themselves, an explicit documented rollback/restore workflow, a review or approval UI for automation changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
